title: Integrative single-cell and bulk analyses reveal ATF4-associated immune suppression and WNT/beta-catenin signaling in osteosarcoma.
authors: Ding, Xiaomin; Chen, Feihu; Zhou, Jin; Xu, Dawei
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过单细胞和bulk转录组分析骨肉瘤中ATF4相关的免疫抑制与WNT信号，虽涉及转录因子ATF4和分子对接/MD模拟，但核心是肿瘤预后与免疫特征，非TF-DNA结合互作机制研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Osteosarcoma (OS) is highly heterogeneous and often exhibits an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, contributing to poor outcomes. The cell-type-resolved role of the ATF/CREB stress-response network, particularly ATF4, remains unclear in OS. METHODS: We integrated public OS single-cell RNA-seq and bulk transcriptome cohorts. Single-cell analyses included malignant program discovery (cNMF), regulon inference (SCENIC), and cell-cell communication (CellChat). Bulk cohorts (TARGET and GEO) were used to build and validate a prognostic model. ATF4-associated immune features were assessed using ESTIMATE, immune deconvolution, and TIDE-related metrics. WNT/beta-catenin activity was evaluated by gene-set scoring. ATF4-related drugs were screened using DSigDB/Enrichr and assessed by docking. Sorafenib was selected for molecular dynamics simulation. ATF4 function was validated by siRNA knockdown (MG63, U2OS) and overexpression (HOS). RESULTS: A stress-associated malignant program showed enriched ATF/CREB activity and prominent signaling interactions. Intersecting its markers with ATF/CREB genes identified ATF3/ATF4/CREB5, which were used to construct an ATF/CREB-associated risk score (ACS) that stratified survival in TARGET and external cohorts. ATF4 showed the most consistent adverse prognostic association and remained an independent factor in multivariate analyses. ATF4-high tumors were associated with a more immunosuppressive profile and stronger WNT/beta-catenin signaling, and these features tracked with the ACS. Among the compounds tested in silico, sorafenib ranked highest in docking, and subsequent molecular dynamics simulations suggested that the ATF4-sorafenib interaction can remain stable. In cell-based assays, silencing ATF4 curtailed proliferation, colony formation, and migration, accompanied by reduced beta-catenin, CyclinD1, and c-MYC. By contrast, ATF4 overexpression led to the opposite pattern. CONCLUSION: Our results place ATF4 at the intersection of stress-related tumor programs, immune suppression, and WNT/beta-catenin activation in OS, and this pattern is associated with poorer clinical outcomes. The ACS offers a practical way to stratify risk, and sorafenib warrants further evaluation as a potential ATF4-oriented therapeutic lead.
abstract_zh: 背景：骨肉瘤（Osteosarcoma, OS）具有高度异质性，常表现出免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境，导致预后不良。ATF/CREB应激反应网络在细胞类型层面的作用，尤其是ATF4，在OS中仍不明确。方法：我们整合了公共OS单细胞RNA测序和批量转录组队列。单细胞分析包括恶性程序发现（cNMF）、调控子推断（SCENIC）和细胞间通讯（CellChat）。批量队列（TARGET和GEO）用于构建和验证预后模型。使用ESTIMATE、免疫去卷积和TIDE相关指标评估ATF4相关免疫特征。通过基因集评分评估WNT/β-catenin活性。使用DSigDB/Enrichr筛选ATF4相关药物，并通过对接进行评估。选择索拉非尼进行分子动力学模拟。通过siRNA敲低（MG63、U2OS）和过表达（HOS）验证ATF4功能。结果：一个应激相关恶性程序显示出富集的ATF/CREB活性和显著的信号相互作用。将其标记基因与ATF/CREB基因交叉，鉴定出ATF3/ATF4/CREB5，用于构建ATF/CREB相关风险评分（ACS），该评分在TARGET和外部队列中分层了生存差异。ATF4表现出最一致的不良预后关联，并在多变量分析中保持为独立因素。ATF4高表达肿瘤与更免疫抑制的特征和更强的WNT/β-catenin信号相关，这些特征与ACS一致。在计算机模拟测试的化合物中，索拉非尼在对接中排名最高，随后的分子动力学模拟表明ATF4-索拉非尼相互作用可保持稳定。在细胞实验中，沉默ATF4抑制了增殖、集落形成和迁移，并伴随β-catenin、CyclinD1和c-MYC减少。相反，ATF4过表达导致相反模式。结论：我们的结果将ATF4定位在OS中应激相关肿瘤程序、免疫抑制和WNT/β-catenin激活的交汇点，且这一模式与较差的临床结局相关。ACS提供了一种实用的风险分层方法，索拉非尼作为潜在的ATF4导向治疗先导物值得进一步评估。
